'''Team Flash''' is an Singaporean organization. They acquired the roster and slot of [[Sky Gaming]] for [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Season|VCS 2019 Summer]]. They once had a [[Team Flash.Singapore|Singaporean team]] that played in [[The Legends Circuit/Singapore/2017 Season/Spring|TLC-SG]].

== History ==
=== 2019 Summer ===
[[Sky Gaming]]'s roster and slot were acquired by '''Team Flash''', along with players [[Stark (Phan Công Minh)|Stark]] and [[YiJin]], the team seemed destined to earn a seed for the [[2019 Season World Championship<!--/Main Event-->|2019 Season World Championship Main Event]]. However, after a 2nd place finish in the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Season| Summer Season]] the team would first lose to [[GAM Esports]] 3-0 in the Grand Final, before losing 3-1 to [[Lowkey Esports.Vietnam|Lowkey Esports]], failing to qualify for the [[2019 Season World Championship<!--/Main Event-->|2019 Season World Championship Main Event]], finishing 3rd.

=== 2020 Spring ===
After the disappointment of not qualifying for Worlds '''Team Flash''' acquired [[Yoshino]] from [[GAM Esports]], and both [[Artemis (Trần Quốc Hưng)|Artemis]] and [[Hinn]] left the team. '''Team Flash''' would also hire two rookie players [[Jesh]] and [[PinkA]] during the split.  

[[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]] would again finish 2nd in the [[VCS 2020 Spring|Regular Season]], being the only team to win more than one map against the dominant [[GAM Esports]]. However, this time [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]] would succeed in the Grand Final against [[GAM Esports]] winning the series 3-2.
